curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: value the role of listening in communication.

mission.title: value the role of listening in communication.

interactions.prompt: Akinyi is speaking. What should Kamau do?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Looking and listening shows that the speaker matters.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the child whose eyes and ears are ready.

interactions.prompt: Teacher says, ‘Touch your head, then clap.’ Which action shows careful listening?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Careful listening helps us follow directions in order.
interactions.retryHint: Remember the first action and then the second.

interactions.prompt: Musa says, ‘I lost my red pencil.’ Which reply shows you listened?
interactions.feedback: Wonderful listening! The reply matches what Musa said.
interactions.retryHint: Which reply mentions the lost red pencil?

interactions.prompt: Listen to this message: ‘Please put the cup beside the plate.’ Choose the correct picture.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Listening helped you place the cup correctly.

interactions.prompt: Your friend tells you how they feel. What is the kind listening choice?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Listening helps friends understand and care for one another.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the action that lets your friend finish speaking.

interactions.prompt: Why is listening important when we communicate?
interactions.feedback: You got it! Listening helps messages travel clearly between people.
interactions.retryHint: Think about how you know what another person means.
